mapper.insert: insert into minor_guardian_authorization (guardian_member_id, purpose, policy_version, relation, evidence_method, status, request_id, invite_token_hash, invite_expires_at, valid_days, create_time) values (#{guardianMemberId}, #{purpose}, #{policyVersion}, #{relation}, #{evidenceMethod}, #{status}, #{requestId}, #{inviteTokenHash}, #{inviteExpiresAt}, #{validDays}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select from minor_guardian_authorization where guardian_member_id = #{guardianMemberId} and request_id = #{requestId}
mapper.update: update minor_guardian_authorization set status = 'REVOKED', revoked_at = #{now}, revoked_by = #{memberId}, invite_token_hash = null, invite_expires_at = null, update_time = #{now} where id = #{id} and status in ('PENDING', 'ACTIVE') and (guardian_member_id = #{memberId} or ward_member_id = #{memberId})
mapper.select: select from minor_guardian_authorization where guardian_member_id = #{memberId} or ward_member_id = #{memberId} order by id desc limit 200
